def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A uniform separator column divides side-by-side panels.
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)), None)
    if sep_col is not None and 0 < sep_col < w - 1:
        panel = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        bg = max(set(v for row in panel for v in row),
                 key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in panel))
        return [[3 if v == bg else v for v in row] for row in panel]

    # A uniform separator row divides vertically stacked panels.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if sep_row is not None and 0 < sep_row < h - 1:
        panel = grid[:sep_row]
        bg = max(set(v for row in panel for v in row),
                 key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in panel))
        return [[3 if v == bg else v for v in row] for row in panel]

    return grid
